title: Apply for a dangerous goods driver licence
summary: This page provides information and steps on how to apply for a dangerous goods driver licence.
intro:
You need a dangerous goods driver licence if you want to transport dangerous goods:

Intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) with a total capacity of up to 3,000 litres are exempt, as long as they are not filled or emptied while on the vehicle.

You can apply online via eConnect EPA.
who_can_apply: Have completed the training course 'TLILIC0001 Course in the transport of dangerous goods by road'.
Be certified as medically fit to drive by a general practitioner (GP).
what_you_need: Copies of required documents for online upload.

how_to_steps.text: Select 'Register to start a new application' and follow the prompts to apply.

more_info.text: If you hold a current dangerous goods driver licence issued by another state or territory, you're able to drive a dangerous goods vehicle in NSW.

internal_links.text: Apply for a dangerous goods vehicle licence

faqs.q: Who needs a dangerous goods driver licence?
faqs.a: You need this licence if you plan to transport dangerous goods.

faqs.q: Are all dangerous goods exempt from this licence?
faqs.a: Intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) with a total capacity of up to 3,000 litres are exempt, provided they are not filled or emptied while on the vehicle.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You can apply online via eConnect EPA.
